summary_zh: 一个用于预训练和微调 AI 模型的深度学习框架，通过组织 PyTorch 代码自动化反向传播、混合精度、多 GPU 与分布式训练等工程环节，并可在不改动核心代码的情况下从 CPU 扩展到多节点 GPU。
audience_zh: 适合使用 PyTorch 训练模型的开发者与研究人员，尤其是希望减少重复工程代码、简化多 GPU 和分布式训练，同时保留模型逻辑控制权的用户；需要专家级控制的人也可选择 Fabric。

evidence.quote: **The deep learning framework to pretrain and finetune AI models.**

Training models in plain PyTorch requires writing and maintaining a lot of repetitive engineering code. Handling backpropagation, mixed precision, multi-GPU, and distributed training is error-prone and often reimplemented for every project. PyTorch Lightning organizes PyTorch code to automate this i

nfrastructure while keeping full control over your model logic. You write the science. Lightning handles the engineering, and scales from CPU to multi-node GPUs without changing your core code. PyTorch experts can still opt into [expert-level control](#lightning-fabric-expert-control).
Lightning gives you granular control over how much abstraction you want to add over PyTorch.
